name: Transit router exactInputV3Swap trusts caller-supplied pools
summary: TransitSwapRouterV5's exactInputV3Swap accepts a caller-supplied list of pools and pays each hop through the pool's swap callback without checking that the pool is a real PancakeSwap V3 pool. The attacker passed its own contract as the first pool, so the router settled the fake hop from the 43,842 USDT it held and swapped it onward to the attacker as BNB.
notes: A different defect and router from the 2022 Transit Swap callBytes incident. The owner's post-deployment calls set the fee and per-address mappings, which the exploit path does not read as gates.
Loss is the USDT the router held; it was swapped to 173.9 BNB for the attacker.
